title: Use a scatter plot for pairs
summary: A scatter plot shows paired measurements as separate points. It helps reveal a relationship without connecting every point.
introduction: A scatter plot shows paired measurements as separate points. It helps reveal a relationship without connecting every point. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain use a scatter plot for pairs
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A scatter plot shows paired measurements as separate points. It helps reveal a relationship without connecting every point.

blocks.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.scatter([1, 2, 3], [4, 3, 5])
ax.set_xlabel("Practice sessions")
ax.set_ylabel("Points")
plt.show()
blocks.title: Use a scatter plot for pairs

blocks.text: The three points show three paired observations. A pattern alone would not prove one value causes the other.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not claim causation from a simple visual relationship.
